[[File:Watson chathead.png|left]]
'''Watson''' is a [[Treasure Trails]] expert who lives in [[Hosidius]]. He can be found in the large, fenced-in house west of the [[Forthos Ruin]]. Players can trade him one each of [[easy clue|easy]], [[medium clue|medium]], [[hard clue|hard]], and [[elite clue scroll]]s to receive a [[master clue scroll]]/[[master scroll box]]. He will not accept clue scrolls that are still in a box, they must be opened first. [[Sherlock]] skill challenge scrolls may also be given to Watson. Trading in one of each of these clue scrolls for a master clue scroll yields an average profit of {{NoCoins|floor((6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15*{{MasterMimicValue}}) - (3*{{EasyClueValue}} + 4*{{MediumClueValue}} + 5*{{HardClueValue}} + 5*{{EliteClueValue}} + 1/35 * {{EliteMimicValue}} + (1/5+1/15+1/30+1/50)*(6*{{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15*{{MasterMimicValue}})))}} coins (when including the possible master clues as rewards from the lower-tier clues). While there may be a loss on average, the time saved from doing a single master clue versus one of each of the traded in clues can be significant, and the chance at obtaining the [[Bloodhound]] pet is exclusive to master clues.

If you are holding an unfinished master clue in the bank, Watson will hold onto all 4 clues you have given him until you have finished or discarded the master clue you are holding. The player may also use the [[Astral Contact]] spell to check which types of clue they have given to Watson.

Players can receive additional clues of the same type as clues they currently have stored with Watson.

[[Watson's house|Watson's House]] has an upstairs portion that contains the [[Strange casket|Strange Casket]] which is used to fight [[The Mimic]].

[[Watson's house]] also contains a [[Noticeboard (Watson's house)|noticeboard]] where players can view a list of the [[STASH]] units they have built and/or filled. For a fee of 500 coins, one can buy a [[s.t.a.s.h blueprint|blueprint]] so they can build a [[S.t.a.s.h chart|STASH unit tracker]] in their [[player-owned house]]'s [[Study]], which works just like Watson's noticeboard. 

He owns a [[bloodhound]] named [[Gruff McScruff]].

==Transportation==
*Using a [[Watson teleport]] is the quickest way to get here.
*Use the 'Lunch by the Lancalliums' - Hosidius option on the [[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]], and run south-west.
*Use of the [[Lovakengj Minecart Network]] to the Hosidius West stop.
*Use the [[spirit tree]] from the Hosidius [[spirit tree patch]].
*Use the [[Kourend Castle Teleport]] from the [[standard spellbook]], and run south.
*Use the Xeric's Glade option on the [[Xeric's talisman]], and run north-west over the bridge, then west to Watson's house.
*Use the [[Woodcutting Guild]] option on the [[Skills necklace]], and run north.
